w: The one concept is 'I don't get this at all...' in reply to the HYDRA call. It asks no question and seeks no directions, which T3-034 (both readers) needs, and it is not a call (T3-002, my B1): the words show no doing to place.

'Am I doing something wrong?' asks for directions (T3-034); wanting the Funhaus members to react, 'I want to make them proud!', seeks the creators' notice (T3-127, both readers); threatening to leave after a first pixel is criticised is quitting under strain (T3-181). One concept each, as reader A and my B1 have them.

The template overlay, refresh and reload directions and the final template are posted for placers, which the boundary ruled once counts toward T3-070 (named by neither reader, the larger part); the Note is moved away from the hearts and osu, 'basically a total restart' (T3-022); 'Everyone needs to follow this comment and the picture above as the guide' holds placers to one plan (T3-091, reader B and my B1). Reader A's T3-038 rests on two concepts.

Adding to the room's slime, a she slime, a metal slime, a huge Dragonlord, leads (T3-041, reader B and my B1). Coordinates, the refresh reminder and a reference image (T3-070), doubt that the Dragonlord can be made without many hands (T3-136, my B1), and calls to get the she slime back (T3-002) each have three concepts of their own: four themes, more than three placements carry.

'Always defend first, expand second!', boundaries around the core and the end of the 'Era of Expansion' choose upkeep over growth (T3-042, reader A and my B1); two polls decide the sign's length and the Norwegian flag (T3-066, both readers); setting the day's tasks and asking to designate jobs divide the work (T3-103, reader A).

q: Are the room's pieces narrowed to fewer (T3-069), or placers held to one design of one piece (T3-091)?

Coordinates, templates and a colour grid (T3-070), choosing where the leaf and the Villager go (T3-020), and design choices, grey for the light green and a rainbow shirt for the rebuilt Villager (T3-004), as reader B and my B1 have all three.

Coordinates and plans for MCRN, Jibanyan and Emilia lead (T3-070); four concepts run and update the alliance script that builds Emilia, 'it will create it on its own as long as tab is open' (T3-028, reader B and my B1). Judging a drawing too big (T3-004, my B1) has two concepts.

Coordinates, the correctly proportioned flag and the canvas link are given (T3-070); 'What are your coordinates?' and 'Where is it?' ask for them (T3-034, reader B); 'What's place?' is answered '/r/place', the event explained (T3-016, my B1), concepts of their own (conflict CC-011).
A scale proposal, 'REFRESH 30 SECONDS BEFORE YOU PAINT' and the border and field widths are directions for placers (T3-070), as both readers have it. My B1 placed T3-038; no progress is reported.

Templates, landmarks and the mockup lead (T3-070); 820,320 is chosen and then changed (T3-020); a simpler 'CFC and a dragon' and the dispute over a reference that leaves out most of the crest argue the design, which the boundary ruled once counts toward T3-004, as reader B and my B1 have them.

The Bowie template, coordinates and overlay template are given (T3-070); four concepts ask for them, 'Yes, but a template? Pixel guideline?' (T3-034); the Discord is given (T3-014), a concept of its own, as reader B has all three. The overlay script (T3-028, my B1) is the overlay template's tool.
Step plans, pixel maps and overlays (T3-070) and flag scripts written, checked and run 'if you go to sleep, or to work' (T3-028), as both readers have them. My B1 left the scripts out.

Both readers place T3-070. Coordinates, dimensions, mock-ups and templates for the Gator mark lead (T3-070); three concepts add Albert to the existing logo (T3-041, reader B), concepts of their own.

The one concept is a lone 'l' posted as a canvas coordinate link, which both readers read as a location shared (T3-070). I left it unplaced at B1.

Layouts, a colour list and a monochrome forsenE are posted for placers (T3-070); two concepts make and write scripts to build and rebuild forsenE (T3-028, reader A and my B1). Three accounts and the NA shift are one concept each.

Directions for drawing the face and the top-left start (T3-070), as both readers have it, and choosing and moving the spot (T3-020, my B1) hold five concepts each. A canvas that desyncs and needs reloading (T3-074) and asking which corner the coordinates mark (T3-034) have three or more each: four themes, more than three placements carry. Reader B flagged a bag.

Both readers place the coordinates, reference, lettering and tile positions (T3-070). Two concepts argue the design, 'Stop making Fred taller, he's complete' and 'It's too big. There's a reason we're only doing the Flintstar', which the boundary ruled once counts toward T3-004 (my B1).

Battleplans, diagrams and links are posted (T3-070); the Art Application Form, the approved-projects document and 'no new submissions can be approved' vet others' requests to build (T3-162, reader A and my B1); diplomats are sent to the Discord for 'diplomacy talks', other rooms in the chat (T3-153, my B1).
A template is asked for, supplied, confirmed as the original and reposted (T3-070), as both readers have it. My B1 T3-091 needs one plan held against others; no rival version is in the words.
